acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fae family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fae Noble, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Mask-Court Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Living leaf-and-flower gown, mask-like face without eye whites, hovering mote court, and crown of thorns and blossom.
Signature mechanic: Still Court: the thorn-and-blossom crown names one sector, the no-white eyes fix another, and motes lift the living leaf gown over the actual command lane.
battlefieldDuty: Control alternating court sectors by turning a mask-like face while a mote court lifts one living-gown hem.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 the palm-sized body, simple insect wings, and thorn grip gain one pressure-thread anchor; T2 layered petal wings gain directional seam channels; T3 stained glass and branch antlers gain pane vanes; T4 gown, mask, and mote court gain still thorn clasps; T5 impossible geometry, season crown, and reality bend gain bounded pressure facets.

Motion/process branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn feint drives insect-wing dust around one still anchor; T2 layered petals direct flow outer-to-inner; T3 stained glass and antlers redirect one pane vector; T4 the gown and mask court cycle gusts around a clasp; T5 the season crown redirects and stills one reality facet.
counterplay: Follow the lifted hem rather than the gaze and cut the exposed living seam after the court passes. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn grip exposes its still pressure anchor after the insect-wing feint; T2 a layered petal seam opens its still channel after flow; T3 stained glass and antlers expose the vane anchor between vectors; T4 the gown and mask court expose a still clasp between gusts; T5 the season crown and impossible reality facet expose its pressure break at the still interval.
forbiddenTreatments: Native flight alone presented as Wind affinity
identityInvariants: A slender weightless-looking silhouette retains layered wings while scale, head growth, and proportion change only at explicit tiers.
Spring green, petal pink, dusk violet, moth iridescence, and bounded gold pollen light remain source palette rather than affinity evidence.
Living leaf, petal, spider silk, stained glass, bark, dew, and moth wing remain discrete ordinary or uncanny materials.
Wing complexity and subtly wrong beauty escalate from a palm sprite to a sovereign whose geometry bends the surrounding frame.
telegraph: The mask face stays still as one gown hem rises and the hovering court condenses beneath it.
